conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: In quantum computing, superposition means a quantum bit (qubit) can be both 0 and 1 simultaneously, unlike a classical bit which is either 0 or 1. Entanglement is when two or more qubits become linked and share the same fate, even when physically separated.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Those are pretty abstract concepts. Do you have any analogies or simple examples that might help illustrate them?

conversation.message: Those are really helpful analogies. So, what kind of problems are quantum computers expected to solve that classical computers struggle with?
